concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work. Compiler-emitted structures are fresh and owned by the caller; the volatile run envelope is the only per-call value and never enters the plan body.
inputs: closed immutable tuple[NormalizedResource] from the accepted normalizer
optional declaration-only static_readiness map from the accepted SemanticsGraph
purpose: Resolve exactly one System, at most one Deployment bound to it and exactly one Scenario from the closed normalized resource set, emit the selected logical identities, declared parameters and declared seed into the resolved plan, and reject any missing, unresolved or ambiguous selection with a stable structured diagnostic and no plan.
state: Owns no durable or cached state. Receives immutable NormalizedResource values, returns a fresh plan dict plus sorted diagnostics and a volatile run envelope; persists, journals and mutates nothing.

static_checks.expected: static inspection of the selection branch shows no default identity, no first-match fallback and no partial selection return
static_checks.rule: selection emits exactly one System/Scenario identity and a null-only Deployment when absent
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse, jsonschema meta-schema validation, additive diff scope check)

title: XDL1-SR-001-U unit specification - Declared Scenario selection and binding

unit_cases.precondition: normalized set with zero System resources
normalized set with two System resources
one System and no Scenario referencing it
two Scenarios that both reference the selected System
two Deployments referencing the selected System
exactly one Deployment present but the selected Scenario declares no deploymentRef to it

unit_cases.expected: resolved plan; selection.deployment is null, bindings == [] and no error diagnostic
unit_cases.precondition: no Deployment in the closed set

unit_cases.expected: plan.selection.scenario identity equals the declared Scenario; seed.value/unitSemantics and parameters list equal the declared payload in order
unit_cases.precondition: admitted valid set with declared seed and two ordered parameters

unit_cases.expected: plan.selection.staticReadiness equals the accepted declaration-only readiness map with values in {Ready,NotReady,NotEvaluated}; plan.nonReadiness is present
unit_cases.precondition: valid set with a Deployment carrying declared artifacts

unit_cases.expected: plan.initialConditions equals the declared object verbatim and plan.acceptanceIntent equals the declared value or null when absent
